verdict.rationale: Open WebUI documents its own webhooks feature, including a user-registrable personal webhook that fires an outbound notification when a chat response is ready. However, the evidence shows only narrow event coverage and names chat-app targets like Discord and Slack rather than a general event-subscription API for programmatic consumers. Missing for 10: a documented catalog of subscribable event types, a generic HTTP payload schema or delivery semantics (retries, signing), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: A personal webhook that notifies individual users when a response to their chat is ready, especially useful for long-running tasks.
receive automated notifications in external services like Discord, Slack ... as well as post messages from external services into Open WebUI channels.
